Manhood: Returning to Our Roots B. Tener 1 Preface Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one. — Marcus Aurelius, Meditations   Often times I think about my past and what I could have done better. However, the past has made me who I am. The real question is, how can I help people from going down that same dark and depressing road. This book is a collaboration effort by men who have endured the worst that our society has to offer. We have overcome our many trials through years of grueling fighting and experimentation. This book is a project which has been brewing for many years and is teeming with heaps of wisdom. We seek to help those who have been tactfully exploited by our society in hopes of restoring them into strong men once again. In retrospect, to have a resource like this book would have been life changing. Whether I would have read it and taken seriously is another story. However, the lack of material on this subject other than the countless YouTube videos is astonishing. This book is not meant to bash these YouTubers, they are doing God’s work. On the contrary, the point of this book is to be the foundational guide for a man living in our modern world. For some, this book will be the ultimate resource that they have been searching for. Others may not take it seriously at all and while saddening, it is their choice. However, with anything, a skeptical and brutally honest attitude is required to truly understand the content and make a judgement call. The ability to critically think by isolating the truth from the abundant falsities of this world is the first skill required in becoming a strong man. The content of your character is your choice. Day by day, what you choose, what you think and what you do is who you become. — Heraclitus, Peri Physeos   As men, we must be prepared to separate the wheat from the chaff every single day. 1.1 Authorities   Throughout this resource you will see many authors quoted. They may be philosophers, saints, authors, ancient writers, and fictional characters. The basis for this book is grounded in the truth of the Bible. Some may scoff at this statement. However, morality (discussed later) is an essential part of being a man. Anything can be anything without Truth. For those who are opposed to the Bible or skeptical of it’s usage, read the whole book. The authors intentions are not to force religion down your throat, there is no use in that. Instead, we seek to use the Bible as the ultimate foundation and basis for the views discussed later. At the end of this book, whether you decide to follow the God of the Bible is a choice only you can make. 1.2 References   Throughout the book, definitions will be highlighted and linked to their corresponding definition in the “Definitions” section. References to unlisted sources (studies, videos, podcasts, websites, etc.) will be linked for easy access. When available, primary sources will be used to further reinforce the truth with which we seek to share. 1.3 Acknowledgements   This book is a labor of love which has been developed through many years of research and anecdotal experiences. I want to personally thank my friends, Dynel and Caleb, for their deep thoughts and questions which have contributed to the content of this book. Thank you to all the contributors who made this book possible and the many lives that have and will be changed for the better because of it.

It has how we as humans have survived thousands of years on a planet full of threats. Throughout all time, we see that the wealthy brush off core disciplines in favor of voluptuous living. These typically included hard work, service, exercise, and even honor. For a man, testosterone is the biggest component of his physical body. Reducing exercise and increasing worthless pleasures often diminishes such ample testosterone levels. It is difficult to correlate any meaningful facts between obesity and depression with any other symptoms. This is because of the drastic change in lifestyle the west has incurred. Large cities, pollution, plastics, urbanization, industrialization, and isolation have all come to affect our day to day lives. The unfortunate truth of our lives is that large corporations profit off our sickness. They entrench us in a cycle from the day we are born till the day we die. The cycle: listen, do not think, the experts are always correct. Skepticism of non qualified people is treated as a child’s questioning of their parents. What they want is for you not to own anything and to be happy.  Lounging around, neglecting exercise, emphasizing stress, and overeating are all problems which the average American faces. The key thing to keep in mind is that when doing these things you relinquish your rights to your body to the corporation who feeds, entertains, stresses, and medicates you. They want to use and abuse you. Break out of this cycle and take your life into your own hands. Wake up earlier and go to the gym. Break that stigma that you could never be a runner. Go enroll in a sports league. These are all healthy things that not only support your physical health but will also overflow benefits into the rest of your life. You will notice less brain-fog, a more productive attitude, better sleep, a happier demeanor, and a healthier and fit body. We often become too shortsighted to think about the future. One future I often think about is my physical health when I grow old. Will I have dementia and laying on my deathbed for five years, or will I be clear thinking and squatting to retrieve my grandchildren. These are the kinds of questions that ought to spur you in your exercise.  Exercise does not have to be a mentally stressful activity. You should start slow and work on building a solid weekly routine. A bulletproof plan for both the youthful and the aging is a hybrid workout regime. This regime includes activities like running / walking, biking, sports, weightlifting, and specialized mobility work. Train like our ancestors lived in their nomadic lifestyles. The plan is the same for both the youthful and the aging, build cardiovascular health, strong and enduring muscles, flexible and mobile joints, a bulletproof and tactical mind, and a joyful spirit. Playing sports is especially important because of the camaraderie between players. It also helps you to retain your neural pathways by using your brain to make quick decisions. This will help the mind to stay fit while you keep your body in order.  It is never to late to start. 2.4 Generation: Isolated (WIP)   2.4.1 Forever Gaming   2.4.2 Social Media: Depravity Hub
